pointers.shared: The plan's four cases, carried here with the node that owns each

purpose.s: A failure case is the answer to "what happens when" for a node; a node volume cites the case by anchor and adds only what is specific to it.
Every case ends in a record with a code from status-codes.xml and, where the owner must act, in exactly one card; a case with no record is a silent failure and a defect in this volume.

failure-case.title: A run stops making progress
failure-case.symptom: A lease is past expires_at with no renewal, or a heartbeat shows no progress for stall_seconds while the launcher is alive.
failure-case.detected-by: N-12 on the stall tick (stall.tick_seconds 15) from the heartbeats table and the process table; never from a pane or a model (principles.xml#probes-not-opinions).
failure-case.response: N-02 sweeps the lease, bumps the generation and writes lease.expired 500; N-12 kills the process group (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 10 s) and writes stall (run killed, lease revoked, reason); N-11 decides attempt n+1 with backoff or dead after 3.
A launcher that is alive but whose seat is silent is killed_stall; a launcher that is gone is killed_lease_lost; the record names which.
failure-case.records: lease.expired 500, stall 500, attempt 100 or dead 500, seat.result blocked 423 with the terminal reason.
failure-case.owner-sees: One alert row naming the reason and the next attempt (N-41); a card only on dead.
failure-case.never: A seat is never nudged, prompted or asked whether it is stuck; a stall never extends a deadline.

failure-case.title: The service or a unit crashes
failure-case.symptom: The Go service, a tier unit or a launcher exits unexpectedly.
failure-case.detected-by: systemd (Restart=always in 5 s, no start limit) and the unit.started record with reason on every start; N-06 counts starts in a ten-minute window.
failure-case.response: The unit restarts; migrations re-run idempotently; the scheduler re-attaches to running Jenkins builds by build number (state-store.xml#table-plans); a launcher restart adopts a live run against the same deadline (seat-contract.xml#one-shot); three starts in ten minutes is unit.crashloop 500 and one card, and the unit keeps restarting because a dark line is worse than a noisy one.
failure-case.records: unit.started 100 with reason, unit.crashloop 500, heartbeat adopted true.
failure-case.owner-sees: A card on crashloop; the health lamp amber during the restart; nothing on a single restart.
failure-case.never: Never a manual restart as the fix; never a start limit that leaves the line dark.

failure-case.title: A seat produced output that fails its schema or its acceptance
failure-case.symptom: structured_output fails record.schema.json, a validator command exits non-zero on main, a review returns changes, or a gate is red.
failure-case.detected-by: The launcher's validator (schema_invalid), N-18 (validator.refused with the command), N-19 (review.changes 422), N-08 (gate.verdict red 422).
failure-case.response: A result is never retried as a transient (V05): N-11 cuts attempt n+1 with the evidence in the brief (a fresh seat; a rework resumes the session with the verdict in the brief); after 3, dead 500 and one card.
A red main is rejected 422 with merge.hold (N-10); the fix ticket names the hold id and is the only merge allowed under it.
failure-case.records: seat.result blocked 423 (schema_invalid, output_rejected), validator.refused 422, review.changes 422, attempt 100, dead 500, rejected 422, merge.hold 423.
failure-case.owner-sees: A card on dead or on rejected main; the rest is the alerts list.
failure-case.never: Never a retry of a failed assertion; never a merge of a PR whose head moved after its review.

failure-case.title: Two writers or a merge conflict
failure-case.symptom: A compare-and-swap miss, an idempotency key with a different payload, a claim race at readiness, a workspace claim overlap, or git refusing the merge.
failure-case.detected-by: N-01 in the write transaction (409 record.conflict); N-03 in the ticket.ready transaction; N-14 at provision; N-09 from gh pr merge or the mergeability field of the snapshot.
failure-case.response: The loser re-reads and retries inside its 3 attempts; merge.conflict 409 wakes the worker with a merge-main attempt (N-11 row for 409); a claim overlap without an attempt goes back to N-03 as waiting, not to N-11.
failure-case.owner-sees: Nothing unless the conflict exhausts 3 attempts (then dead and one card).
failure-case.never: Never a silent overwrite; never a second in-flight ticket on a claimed file.
failure-case.source: 02-MAPPING V02 claim before act, V07; memory one-file-one-in-flight-ticket.

failure-case.title: An old-line rule refuses a rebuild ticket
failure-case.symptom: A hook, guard, cap or status rule of the old line refuses a step of a rebuild ticket while build mode is on.
failure-case.detected-by: N-11 matches the refusal string against the old-rule table (principles.xml#build-mode).
failure-case.response: The refusal is written as rule.bit 300 with the rule name, costs no attempt, and raises one fix ticket request per rule name; N-13 stops rendering the rule into rebuild seats.
failure-case.owner-sees: The rule.bit count on the stats screen; no card.
failure-case.never: Never a rebuild ticket blocked by a rule it is exempt from; never a hand override.

failure-case.title: A step's outcome is unknown
failure-case.symptom: A process died between acting and recording (a deletion ran, a Drive upload finished, a gh call returned nothing), so the record is missing but the effect may exist.
failure-case.detected-by: The next tick finds a lease held by a dead holder, a plan in state running with no result, or a cursor behind the newest merge.
failure-case.response: Re-run the step idempotently by its key: a deletion lists first and deletes only what remains; an upload checks the version folder; a merge checks the PR state (MERGED is success, not a second merge); never a blind repeat.
failure-case.records: The step's own record on completion, with attempt unchanged and note "re-run after unknown outcome"; cleanup.run with remaining; drive.copy with the rows found.
failure-case.owner-sees: Nothing; a card only when the re-run itself fails 3 times.
failure-case.never: Never a retry that could delete, publish or merge twice.

failure-case.title: The store fails its integrity check
failure-case.symptom: PRAGMA quick_check is not ok at open, or a page error surfaces on a read.
failure-case.detected-by: N-01 at open and on the health tick; the WAL size check (store.wal_large).
failure-case.response: gRPC Health goes NOT_SERVING; N-05 prepares a dry-run restore from the newest verified backup into STATE/store/restore/ and verifies it; one card carries the backup id, its top_seq and the records that would be lost; the owner confirms on the card before any file is swapped.
failure-case.records: store.corrupt 500, health.unhealthy 503 reason store, backup restore-drill 201 or 500.
failure-case.owner-sees: One card with the restore plan and the loss window.
failure-case.never: Never an automatic restore over the live file; never dispatch while NOT_SERVING.
failure-case.source: N-01 and N-05 spec volumes; C34 backups scheduled.

failure-case.title: Free space under the floor
failure-case.symptom: Free space on the state root is under store.min_free_mib or backup.min_free_mib.
failure-case.detected-by: N-01 before a put, N-05 before a backup, N-06 on the health tick.
failure-case.response: Puts are refused 503 store.disk once per transition and the backup run is skipped with backup.disk 503; N-45 runs its registry cleanup first (expired leases, old logs, old backups by class); one card only if still under after that.
failure-case.records: store.disk 503, backup.disk 503, cleanup.run 200 or 500, health.unhealthy 503 reason disk.
failure-case.owner-sees: One card after cleanup if the floor still holds.
failure-case.never: Never delete the newest verified backup or the live database to make room.
failure-case.source: N-01, N-05 and N-45 spec volumes; owner C35.

failure-case.title: A ticket waits past its stale bound
failure-case.symptom: A ticket in status waiting for longer than intake.stale_days.
failure-case.response: ticket.stale 500 once and one card; the owner cancels or re-cuts through N-29; nothing dispatches it meanwhile.
failure-case.records: ticket.stale 500, then cancel or a new ticket.
failure-case.owner-sees: One card naming the ticket with its full title, its unmet deps or claimed files, and the recommendation.
failure-case.never: Never a silent drop; never an automatic cancel.

failure-case.title: GitHub does not answer
failure-case.symptom: Three request attempts of a poll fail, or a push during the gitops manifest update fails.
failure-case.detected-by: N-04 per poll (forge.request_seconds 10, poll budget 20 s); N-35 on its bounded pull-rebase-push.
failure-case.response: The snapshot entity is marked stale with failed_since; forge.unreachable 503 once per transition; N-08 reads pending; N-09 holds merges; polls continue every tick; one card after three failed polls past forge.stale_after_seconds; forge.recovered 200 on the first success. N-35 stops at 3 with deploy.timeout 504 and the next merge record retries it.
failure-case.owner-sees: A card after the stale bound; the forge lamp amber meanwhile.
failure-case.never: Never a merge on a stale snapshot; never a webhook as the recovery path.

failure-case.title: A second service instance is started
failure-case.symptom: A second binary is started by hand or by a stray unit.
failure-case.response: The second instance exits 3 and writes unit.duplicate 500 naming the holder pid through the first instance's socket; RestartPreventExitStatus=3 stops systemd from looping it.
failure-case.owner-sees: An alert row; a card at the second occurrence in a day.
failure-case.never: Never two writers on the store.

failure-case.title: WSL suspends and wakes
failure-case.symptom: The host sleeps; every ticker misses its interval.
failure-case.detected-by: Each ticker compares the expected and actual gap on wake.
failure-case.response: Tickers fire once each; the tick counter shows the gap; tick.missed once per subkind; leases past expiry are swept normally on the next stall tick, and seats whose deadline passed during the gap are killed_deadline.
failure-case.records: tick.missed 500 per subkind, tick 100 with the gap.
failure-case.owner-sees: An alert row; a card only at three tick.missed in an hour.
failure-case.never: Never a burst of catch-up ticks.

many-agents.readers: Every node cites the cases it owns; the review seat reads this volume as the list of "what happens when" questions a volume must answer.
many-agents.writers: A new case is a pull request on this file cut from a dead record or a defect ticket; the node it names gets a sibling pointer in the same PR.
many-agents.collision: Two nodes that handle one case in different ways is a defect found by N-46 (two volumes citing one anchor with contradicting responses is a review finding), resolved by the node named first in the case's nodes attribute.
